# API Standards

This directory contains standards for designing, developing, and managing APIs across the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-000-developer-implementation-guide]

### STD-APP-API-000: Developer Implementation Guide

Comprehensive guide for developers implementing APIs, covering best practices, patterns, and step-by-step implementation instructions.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-001-api-design]

### STD-APP-API-001: API Design

Standards for RESTful API design including resource modeling, URI structure, HTTP methods, status codes, versioning, and documentation.
page_texts.6:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-002-microservices-development]

### STD-APP-API-002: Microservices Development

Standards for developing microservices including service boundaries, communication patterns, data management, and deployment practices.
page_texts.7:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-003-internal-vs-external-api-guidelines]

### STD-APP-API-003: Internal vs External API Guidelines

Standards for differentiating and managing internal APIs (for internal consumption) versus external APIs (for partners/customers), including security, documentation, and support requirements.
page_texts.8:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-004-north-south-vs-east-west-apis]

### STD-APP-API-004: North-South vs East-West APIs

Standards for distinguishing north-south APIs (client-to-service) from east-west APIs (service-to-service), including communication patterns, security, and performance considerations.
page_texts.9:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-005-api-gateway-management]

### STD-APP-API-005: API Gateway Management

Standards for deploying and managing API gateways including routing, rate limiting, authentication, monitoring, and gateway selection criteria.
page_texts.10:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-006-api-mesh-vs-gateway-guidance]

### STD-APP-API-006: API Mesh vs Gateway Guidance

Standards for choosing between API mesh and API gateway architectures based on use cases, complexity, and organizational needs.
page_texts.11:
[standards/application/api/README.md#std-app-api-007-aws-api-management-standard-profile]

### STD-APP-API-007: AWS API Management Standard Profile

Standards profile for implementing AWS API Management capabilities while aligning to existing enterprise API, security, and observability controls.
page_texts.12:
[standards/application/api/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Consistent API design across the enterprise
- Clear guidance for different API types and patterns
- Proper API governance and lifecycle management
- Scalable and maintainable API architectures
- Developer productivity and API reusability
